idea-plugin.name: HTML Render
idea-plugin.description:
Opens local HTML files directly in a rendered browser view, just like the built-in Markdown preview.
Features: - Double-click an .html file: it opens rendered immediately (no source, no split). - Editor toolbar buttons switch between Editor / Split / Preview layouts. - A Refresh button reloads the rendered page on demand. - The preview reloads automatically (about 300 ms) after you save the file.
Rendering is powered by the embedded Chromium browser (JCEF) bundled with CLion. Supported IDEs: CLion 2026.2.x.
